verdicts.reason: Welcomes the user and asks a sensible opening question in response to a booking request.
User confirmed first visit; bot moves on to ask what they need help with.
User answered the help question; bot proceeds to the next step of choosing a doctor.

User picked option 1; bot confirms exactly that slot.
